_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Veer Cruiser is a WAGON. Clek's row covers Cruiser / Cruiser XL as one entry; specs below are the 2-seat All-Terrain Cruiser (base model), with the 4-seat Cruiser XL variant noted. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Veer Cruiser (All-Terrain Wagon; Cruiser XL is the 4-seat variant)

clekListed.clekRow: Veer — Cruiser / Cruiser XL — Clek adapter – NEW Clek/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna — New adapter available May 2023

specs._weightNote: Base Cruiser 32.6 lb with wheels / 24.6 lb wheels removed. Cruiser XL is 36.7 lb with wheels / 28.7 lb removed.
specs._dimsNote: Base Cruiser open 37 x 20 x 23 in; folded 37 x 20 x 14 in (9 in with wheels removed); 24 in wheelbase. Cruiser XL is 24 in wide (28 in overall). Wagon folds flat, one-hand, self-standing.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth with infant car seat + adapter or infant insert; ride-in ~6 mo+ (able to sit unassisted) to ~5 yr / 45 in

specs._capacityNote: 55 lb per seat; 2 seats on base Cruiser (4 on Cruiser XL). Cargo-only/pet capacity 250 lb (110 lb on beach wheels). basketCapacityLb here reflects the cargo-only rating, not a separate under-basket.

safety.standards: Meets or exceeds ASTM (16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833) and EN 1888.2 safety standards
safety.notes: Two 3-point safety harnesses (four on Cruiser XL); hose/washable seats; car-seat compatible via adapter (sold separately).

recall.source: CPSC/SaferProducts search — no Veer Cruiser / Cruiser XL wagon recall found

specs.foldType: one-hand flat fold, self-standing; wheels removable to shrink to 9 in tall
specs.recline: seat backs recline; near-flat with infant insert (no multi-position mechanism like a traditional stroller)
specs.tires: large rugged knobby polyurethane foam (never-flat) tires; front swivel wheels with suspension; removable wheels

notes: Wagon, not a conventional stroller. Clek lists 'Cruiser / Cruiser XL' as one row; the NEW Clek/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna adapter (available May 2023, adapter-veer-cruiser) EXPLICITLY supports the Clek Liing. seatCount 2 = base All-Terrain Cruiser (Cruiser XL seats 4). Base Cruiser $699 DTC in stock; Cruiser XL $799 (Baby Cubby sold out at check). Max child 55 lb/seat, up to ~45 in / age 5; birth-capable with car seat + adapter or infant insert.
